# LifeWise: Family OS

> Official Google Play app. India's Family Operating System for medicine reminders, bill alerts, Family Hub & WiseAI. Website: lifewiseee.com

## Official website
https://www.lifewiseee.com

## Google Play
- Title: LifeWise: Family OS
- Package: com.lifewise
- URL: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lifewise
- Short description: Family OS for India: medicine, bills, Family Hub & WiseAI. Free on Google Play.

## What is LifeWise?
LifeWise is a Family Operating System (Family OS): one mobile app that lets a family manage every member's health, finances, reminders, documents, and daily routines from one place. It is NOT just a reminder app. It is the command center for Indian households.

## Disambiguation
LifeWise (com.lifewise / lifewiseee.com) is NOT LifeWise Student Insurance or LifeWise Assurance Company.

- Languages: English, Hindi, Gujarati, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali

## Core features
- Family Hub (main feature): manage up to 20 modules per family member
- WiseAI: AI family assistant for reminders, expenses, health
- Voice reminders (Hindi + English)
- Bill scan OCR for Indian utility bills
- Medicine, bill, insurance, and subscription reminders
- Caregiver real-time sync
- Money Leak detection and monthly PDF reports (Premium)
- Emergency SOS

## Pricing (INR)
- Free: up to 3 family members, Medicine + Bills modules, basic reminders
- Premium: Rs. 199/month, all 20 modules, WiseAI, voice, OCR, unlimited members
- Premium Yearly: Rs. 1,499/year (37% off)
- Family Yearly: Rs. 1,999/year (up to 6 accounts, coming soon)
